description.en: Those who appear in Da Quan’s dream will inevitably face death. But the strange man in his dream suddenly appeared in the real world. Since then, his dreams started changing… Turns out that man can control the dream world!

Do I want to live? Of course I do!

Just before she gets hit by a huge truck, Inseo Han, an ordinary South Korean woman who worked in a research lab, receives a text message offering her a special journey, new relationships, and opportunities for extra income. Determined to make it out of the situation alive, she accepts the offer and soon finds herself in the Raotwan Empire of Laseania as Duke Adrian's 12th fiancee candidate, Isella Derhen. Inseo has to act the role for an entire month in order to make it back to earth alive, but this job requires her to deceive not only a few nobles but the entire empire as well as the emperor. Not only that, but Duke Adrian demands that Inseo must never fall in love with him.

Meanwhile, Adrian, the duke and patriach of House Beleskez, is in search of an adequate fiancee to avoid a royal marriage with the emperor's third daughter, Princess Kiersten. Though things would be very simple if the princess were to marry the duke's son, Lord Aslan, political strife complicates the situation and Adrian cannot simply turn down the marriage. Hence, he seeks someone who can act as his fiancee so he would have a justified reason to avoid the royal marriage until Aslan succeeds the dukedom.

Will Inseo win the deal and the opportunity to save her life? Can she and Adrian pull off the tremendous act without getting caught?

So imagine the shock of suddenly waking up in Penelope’s body—you know right away that your life is on the line. White serpent masquerading as an Imugi x Joyful raccoon that can't stop eating  
  
Halfway up the Crescent Moon Mountain, where humans avoid due to its rugged terrain.  
The white serpent monster Ishimi, was rudely awoken from his hibernation by the raccoons that suddenly appeared. In his rage, Ishimi chose to masquerade as an Imugi and bully the most annoying of the raccoons.  
  
But he didn't know that the raccoon was a monster like him, and could turn into a human form.  
  
The raccoon monster Sokuri, was living with the gaze of raccoons that saved his life.  
  
He had always got into trouble because of his insatiable appetite, but provoking an angry Imugi turned this situation into a deadly one. To repent for his interruption of the to-be dragon's holy sleep, he has to procure him some food, but the reasons behind it seem a bit suspicious? And he keeps requiring his attention for some reason?  
  
The union of the liar snake Ishimi, and the cheerfully gluttonous raccoon Sokuri.

But Lucentia could not escape her fate, as she was the only one who could save the Duke of Aytan, a legendary swordsman who had a secret that could change everything. She proposed that he be her guardian, but he asked her to be his lover.

Lucentia decided that she would no longer be manipulated by fate and that she would live her life as she wanted.

Born on the edge of the world, Turan spent his life as a simple shepherd — hiding a power he was told could destroy everything he loved.

He knew nothing of the wars, the noble houses, or the ancient bloodlines that shaped the land beyond his hills.

And honestly, he's grown a little tired of it.

Watching the world from a distance, never quite knowing what lay past the horizon — until a random encounter cracks the door open, and curiosity does the rest.

With nothing tying him down, Turan steps into a world he has never seen — and slowly, through his eyes, its beauty, its cruelty, and its secrets begin to unfold.

description.en:
The sixth marriage of Princess Lien, whose husband died every first night. This time, I expected a happy married life, but what I came to know was my husband's lover, his illegitimate child, and a cup of poison.

---
Princess Rien Digrit, plagued by a curse where her husbands die on their wedding night, faces betrayal in her sixth marriage. After being murdered, she reawakens on the day of her fifth husband's funeral. Now solely driven by revenge, Rien seeks the ruthless Grand Duke Clocean Ellagadar and agrees to enter a marriage pact with him. But as Clocean erases and alters their contract's terms, insisting she forget its existence, Rien questions his understanding of their arrangement. Is this truly just a contract marriage, or is something deeper unfolding?

description.en:
Rita Estelle knows that Duke Erwan Cereus will fall ill and die, leading to a bloody rebellion. She knows this because she would've died in that rebellion had it not been for a kindly sorceress who sent her back in time. With her second chance at life, Rita seeks to use her medical genius to get close to Duke Erwan as a child and cure him. But the closer she grows to him, the more she suspects his sickness is caused by foul play. Can Rita save Erwan and the whole country before it's too late?
___
When the duke, who was in poor condition, suddenly died, the land fell into the hands of the rebels. In a short time, the rebellion was suppressed by the royal family, but… The point is that I, Lise Estelle, will be hanged for treason. “It’s not fair!” I’m simply the best doctor in the area. If that’s the case, I’ll become the duke’s doctor this time so there’s no rebellion, and I’ll make the duke’s heir healthy! “No one cares about you as much as I do. Therefore, you must definitely listen to me!"
description.fr: Condamnée à mort lors de la Fronde, Rita, médecin de génie, se croit perdue. Mais alors qu'elle donne son ultime consultation, on lui offre une seconde chance. Rita revient dans le passé, le jour de ses 13 ans, et décide d'entrer au service de la famille ducale afin de sauver le petit Lord et d'éviter la Fronde. La jeune médecin n'a plus qu'un objectif: découvrir la source des maladies inconnues qui affaiblissent cette famille. Mais les sauver ne sera peut-être pas seulement de l'ordre du médical!
description.id: Setelah Duke Erwan meninggal, terjadi pemberontakan di wilayah kekuasaannya. Rita, seorang dokter berbakat dijatuhi hukuman mati karena mengobati pemberontak. Namun saat dipenjara, ia bertemu dengan seorang nenek yang mengirimnya kembali ke masa lalu. Akhirnya, Rita berencana mencegah pemberontakan dengan menyelamatkan Duke Erwan. Akankah misi Rita berhasil, dan apa yang terjadi dengan Duke Erwan?

Ela é presa injustamente por tratar os rebeldes, mas em troca de tratar uma velha senhora, ela conseguiu uma nova chance de mudar o presente! A causa da rebelião no passado foi a morte repentina de Ethan, o pequeno príncipe do ducado. Então, o objetivo desta vida é ‘deixar o pequeno duque saudável!’ “Ninguém se importa com Ethan tanto quanto eu!” “Corra! Corra! Você precisa aumentar sua imunidade!” “Coma esta erva. É bom para o seu corpo.” Graças a isso, Ethan consegue ir além da saúde e se tornar um adulto forte. E Lize se demite com facilidade, mas… “Você disse que era a única que estava lá para mim. description.en:
“I never wanted this kind of body either. I wanted to be born with a big, muscular body just like a great hero…!”


The marriage of the unashamed rabbit and the honorable wolf.


Shaila, who chose a political marriage in order to avoid her father, headed to the North.


However, the husband, who was supposed to be the legendary “Black Wolf”, turned out to be nothing but a small, feisty puppy…


“Do you always try to avoid situations by pretending to be cute?”


As long as her husband was this little guy who’s soft as cream bread, Shaila had no intention of leaving the Duke’s Castle.


"Don’t worry about anything. If you can’t become a jewel, I’ll learn alchemy to help you."

"You are special to me. I will definitely make you shine."


Shaila, who knew that her husband suffered from social phobia and self-hatred, gave him confidence.


“In any case… you’re a guy who needs a lot of love and care.”


The cute, little guy grew up to be a big and fearsome wolf thanks to Shaila’s devoted caregiving…


“I’m not even the slightest bit cute anymore, because I’m no longer a little, white, baby puppy…”

"You're still a baby puppy."

"Really?"

"You're still a small, white, cute, little pup. At least, that’s what you’re like in my eyes.”

“What do you think, Shasha? Do you like me?”

"Yeah. I like you just as much as I like chicory."


Shaila loves even the dirtiest parts of me. My Shaila.


Her husband, Callion, was soon enlisted into the army. After he’d been missing for 15 years, the husband she thought was dead had returned as a strong adult man…


“Now that we’re adults, we should kiss like adults.”


Shaila blinked at Callion’s calm voice. She began to recite scripture; after 12 years of monastic life, she didn’t know anything about man and woman skinship.


"How do adults kiss?"


“An adult kiss is not just a peck, Shasha.”

"...Then?"

"It's a french kiss." (Synopsis by: Amethyst Gang)

description.en: Im-rang, who had her boyfriend of 5 years stolen by a trusted friend. She went to their wedding, took a picture with a smile, and prayed for her misfortune. As she was leaving, she met Seon Jae-young, who always made her heart flutter.

Lee Soo-hyuk, the "Master of Thunder," was once hailed as the strongest player. However, during a Tower raid, he was betrayed and killed by a trusted friend.

In his final moments, he exhausted all his power to save his comrades. Yet, despite feeling death take him, he awoke to find himself reincarnated 20 years in the future.

In this new era, the truth has been buried, and the traitor, Kim Il-soo, reigns supreme as the top player. 

To exact his revenge —and for the sake of the allies who might still be waiting for him—Soo-hyuk must become strong again, and fast.

"Doing things the same way as before won't work."

Given a second chance at life, the former champion chooses a new path... Live Streaming! It doesn't matter if the world is full of streamers imitating the legendary Lee Soo-hyuk.

"Because I'm the real deal."

description.en:
One wrong wish and now I have two husbands?!
After finding a wish-granting statue, Renea jumps at the chance to turn her love life around. However, what was supposed to be a wish to make her cheating husband fall in love with her ends up as a wish to marry the hunky statue instead! Can Renea pull off having two husbands without getting caught?
description.pl:
"Proszę, niech mój mąż mnie kocha, nawet w swojej śmierci".

Na posągu, który spełnia życzenia, Renier życzyła sobie miłości swojego zdradzającego męża, ale potem zginęła z jego rąk.
Kiedy ponownie otworzyła oczy, Renier powróciła do momentu, w którym wypowiedziała życzenie.
Ze wszystkich chwil, to musiał być dokładnie ten moment, w którym wypowiedziała słowo "mąż".

Życzenia nie mogły być zmienione, utracone lub zatrzymane w środku. W końcu Renier wypowiedziała życzenie, gdy tylko wyszło z jej ust...

"Proszę, niech mój mąż... Proszę, niech będzie moim mężem!".

Zastanawiała się, czy to życzenie się spełni, skoro poprosiła posąg, by został jej mężem.

"Ja, Veldemer, od tej chwili jestem twoim mężem".

Posąg roztrzaskał się i wyszedł z niego niesamowicie przystojny mężczyzna.
Również nagi.
Spojrzenie Reniera podążyło za jego groźną i przesadną twarzą, za dobrze zarysowanym absem pod szerokimi ramionami, za jędrnymi udami i za jego męskim...!

"Twoje życzenie się spełniło, więc dlaczego nie jesteś szczęśliwy?".

"Ja, To dlatego, że nie masz na sobie ubrań".

"Dlaczego muszę? Jesteś teraz moją żoną..."

szepnął, gdy zbliżył się do Reniera, nie mając na sobie ani jednej nitki.

"Jesteś wolny i możesz oglądać tyle, ile chcesz".

'Jeśli poprosi mnie o to, to zobaczę... 
ale Sir Veldemer zdaje się nie wiedzieć, że mam jeszcze jednego męża, więc jest moim drugim mężem.
W dniu, w którym zostanie to ujawnione, zgadnijcie, że będę musiała pójść do więzienia i zgnić przez 10 lat'.

Zanim to nastąpi, trzeba rozprawić się z jednym z dwóch domów.
Są dwa sposoby.
Rozwód z jej zdradzającym mężem, albo zapieczętowanie Veldemera z powrotem do posągu.

The Greatest Martial Artist, The Ultimate Evil of the Martial World, and the Supreme Terror of the Martial Arts—Blood Wind Lion.

One day, an eight-year-old senior brother, Geom Woo-bin, suddenly appears before them.

“Senior brother, you know we love you, right?”

어릴 때부터 엄마에게 이끌려 사이비종교에 들어갔던 주인공 다혜는 세상과 단절되어 살다가

description.en:
“Things that should not be touched by humans somehow find their way into this world. That’s why you should never, ever touch anything that is foreign.”  
Follow the adventures of March, a Syste Behard, who hunts ils– evil creatures that lurk in fascinating objects.  
  
Among the quiet villages and towns of 18th century Europe, demons known as the Ill hide within the most beautiful works of art, sparked to life by the torment of their creators. Attracted by their jewel-like allure, the unwary find themselves possessed by the Ill and driven to horrific acts of violence. Only the hunters of the Ciste Vihad can dispel the Ill.March is one such hunter, tracking the Ill from town to town to find the antiques that contain the demons before they can possess anyone. If the worst has come to pass, March's full powers are unleashed to battle the fiendish Ill. Born of tragedy, the artifacts all have their own tales to tell, as do each of their victims. But March's story may be the most tragic of all.
description.pt-br:
“Coisas que não deveriam ser tocadas por humanos, de alguma forma, encontram seu caminho neste mundo. É por isso que você nunca, jamais, deve tocar em nada que seja estranho.”

Acompanhe as aventuras de March, um Syste Behard, caçador de ils — criaturas malignas que se escondem em objetos fascinantes.

Entre as pacatas vilas e cidades da Europa do século XVIII, demônios conhecidos como Ill se escondem nas mais belas obras de arte, ganhando vida pelo tormento de seus criadores. Atraídos pelo brilho semelhante a joias, os desavisados acabam possuídos pelos Ill e levados a atos horríveis de violência. Apenas os caçadores do Ciste Vihad podem expulsar os Ill.

March é um desses caçadores, rastreando os Ill de cidade em cidade para encontrar os artefatos que contêm os demônios antes que possuam alguém. Se o pior acontecer, todo o poder de March é liberado para enfrentar os perversos Ill. Nascidos da tragédia, os artefatos têm suas próprias histórias para contar — assim como cada uma de suas vítimas. Mas a história de March pode ser a mais trágica de todas.

description.en: Looked down upon for only possessing two skills, Reckledam has given up on his childhood dream of becoming a warrior and has instead taken a job as a miner to support his chronically ill brother. But when his boss calls upon him to help defeat a monster rampaging deep in the mines, the people who mocked him learn that Reckledam hasn't merely learned the two skills he possesses, he's MASTERED them. Can he be persuaded to rekindle his dream and use his talents for the good of world?

우리엘의 주인님이자 세상이 된 라플레트 모그리스.

하지만 라플레트는 우리엘을 버리고 군인이 되어 마물들이 득실거린다는 황도로 향한다.

description.en:
Wang Dokpil, the boss of Jeolhwa, the largest organization in Chungcheong, and his son, Wang Dam. 

After his father’s death, Wang Dam has a different dream than inheriting his father’s organization and decides to head to Seoul on a whim. But life isn’t that simple, as he envisioned his uncle, who was a member of the organization, proposes a condition that if Wang Dam becomes No. 1 in his new school, he’ll receive a settlement allowance.

However, Wang Dam’s new school, notoriously known as Ppak High, is infamous for school violence. Can Wang Dam become No. 1 in Ppak High School, the one full of the nation’s worst troublemakers?
In a high school classroom ruled by a "queen," a new student struggles to fit in with the other girls. The class has bullies, victims, and onlookers. Will she be able to survive?

Gi Yuh is the leader of the strongest gang in his high school. He lives together with his younger sister, who seems to love him.  
When saving the beautiful Ha Na from a truck he instead gets injured and lies in coma for two weeks. During these two weeks he dives into a strange dreamworld and after his recovery he is not the same anymore. He regularly dreams about what seems to be a past him. To find out what happened to him he asked his teacher for help, who has friends, who deal with fortunetelling and supernatural powers. Here he finds the answer to his strange condition: He is supposed to be a "higher ghost", who takes the position of a dead or soon-dying person.
description.es:
Gi Yuh es el líder de la pandilla más fuerte de su escuela secundaria. Vive con su hermana menor, que parece amarlo.  
Cuando salvó a la hermosa Ha Na de un camión, se lesionó y estuvo en coma por dos semanas. Durante estas dos semanas se sumerge en un extraño mundo de sueños y después de su recuperación ya no es el mismo. Regularmente sueña con lo que parece ser su pasado. Para averiguar lo que le pasó, pidió ayuda a su maestro, que tiene amistades, que se encargan de adivinar el futuro y de los poderes sobrenaturales. Aquí encuentra la respuesta a su extraña condición: Se supone que es un " Fantasma Superior", que toma la posición de una persona muerta o a punto de morir.

Cheon Bi loses all of his internal energy, which was the foundation of martial arts, due to a severe injury and the environment of the North Sea. Heartbroken and at her wit's end, she was ready to accept her death, but then a mysterious entity returns her to her past when she is still a maid. With her second chance at life, Urania is determined to become the king's concubine once more, but this all changes when she meets Oscar, who pushes her to aspire for greater things...

Can Lia escape the grasp of this so-called monster before he remembers that she was the one who hit him?

description.ru:
После года, проведённого в качестве статистки, я подобрала умирающего человека.
Но у него, кажется, амнезия.

"Какие у нас были отношения?"

И странное недоразумение!

"Всякий раз, когда я вижу тебя, мое сердце бешено бьётся и голова кружится".

"Это..."

"Что это, если не любовь?"

Это не любовь, это потому что я разбила тебе затылок

===

Непонимание Диллиана вышло из-под контроля.

"Если мы не любовники, то мы супружеская пара".

"Это не то..."

"Я позабочусь об этом, я буду платить тебе до конца жизни".

"..."

"Итак, жена, ты не должна покидать мою сторону".

Он коснулся моей ноги. Медленно и плавно его рука поднялась вверх, обхватив мою лодыжку.
Как будто меня заковали в кандалы.

"Если я уйду, ты убьёшь меня?".

"Как я могу это сделать?"

Легкомысленно ответил он с улыбкой.

"Я убью того, кто посмеет тебя украсть".

Кажется, я ошиблась...
description.es-la: El 'Duque Monstruoso' que está maldito y una figura oscura, Dillian Sinaize apareció ante mis ojos. “¿Quién diablos le hizo esto?” Está muriendo. No podía fingir que no lo había visto, así que lo traté. “¿No solo ha perdido la memoria, sino que también tiene extrañas ilusiones?” “Cuando te veo, mi corazón late tan rápido y mi mente se marea.” "Bueno eso es…" "Como era de esperar, éramos amantes.” “¡¿No, no nos conocíamos?!” Una vez que comenzó el malentendido todo se salió de control. "Si mi esposa me deja..." "¿No crees que podría matarte?" "No, tienes que matar al tipo que te secuestró". De este hombre aterrador… ¿Podré escapar…?

description.en:
From failed idol to hailed idol!
Flop idol Yongmin dies an unfortunate death but is given a second chance at life in the body of Ian, a super hot rich kid with a voice to match. At his side, he finds Jin, a mysterious soul tasked with guiding Ian to becoming a certified star. But is it really all smooth sailing from here?
description.pt-br:
De idol fracassado a idol aclamado!
O idol fracassado Yongmin teve uma morte miserável, mas recebeu uma segunda chance de viver no corpo de Ian, um garoto rico e gostoso com uma voz à altura da aparência. Ao seu lado, ele encontra Jin, uma alma misteriosa encarregada de guiar Ian para que ele se torne uma estrela de sucesso. Mas será que, a partir de agora, tudo será realmente mais fácil?

description.en: After his first drama flopped, Lee Hyunseok gave up on being a PD. But when he finds himself being granted one last wish in his dying moments, he wants only one thing: to produce the ultimate makjang drama. Now, he's been given a second shot at life (and the assistance of a ghostly PD), but he's on a time crunch to achieve ratings and recognition. With no budget, rookie actors, and an amateur writer, Hyunseok's got his work cut out for him. But what's a good drama without a few twists and turns?

description.en:
"A sparrow who yearns to live a long life aims to capture a human to fulfill her goal… through marriage?!"  
  
In a world where wildlife birds are able to permanently turn into humans once they seal a marriage contract with a human, Jo Ahyoung enters university with the goal of finding her potential marriage partner to live a longer life. Rather than hoping for a romantic meeting, she makes up her mind to take any human that can provide her with a stable and secure living. But is that as easy as she thinks it to be…?
The story of a generation filled with romance and chaos.

description.en: When I realized I had transmigrated as the woman destined to marry my favorite character, Duke Euclid Ludion, I was over the moon. Only cloud on the horizon: I'm a villainess, and based on the storyline, we're headed straight for a divorce. But I won't let that happen! Time to undo all of my character's evil deeds, clear my reputation, use my generous dowry to save Euclid's house from ruin, and win over his beloved wards. Surely, this will be enough to guarantee our happily-ever-after... right?
description.ko:
역하렘 로맨스 판타지 소설에 빙의했다. 
여자 주인공인 사촌 여동생을 지독하게 괴롭히고,
유부녀인 주제에 남자 주인공 중 한 명인 황태자를 스토킹하는
작중 최악의 막장 악녀, 이브게니아에게!

그.러.나!

악녀의 남편이 바로 내 최애였다.
여자 주인공이니, 남자 주인공이니 알아서들 살라 하고,
나는 내 최애와 알콩달콩 잘 먹고 잘살 생각이었다.
그런데……

“이혼해 주세요, 부인.”

남편이 울먹거리며 어이없는 말을 한다.
눈망울이 촉촉하게 젖은 얼굴에 절로 마음이 약해졌다.
그래, 최애를 위해서라면.
네가 원하는 게 나와의 이혼이라면……!

“응, 안돼. 돌아가요.”

딴 건 몰라도 이혼은 절대 못 해줘!
나는 유클리드의 면상에 대고 이혼 서류를 찢어발겼다.
description.ru:
Я очнулась внутри романа в жанре фэнтези с реверс‑гаремом!
И не кем-нибудь, а самой ужасной злодейкой истории — Евгенией,
которая изводила свою кузину, главную героиню,
а заодно, будучи замужем, преследовала наследного принца — одного из главных мужских персонажей.
То есть, настоящее дно из всех возможных!

Но есть одно “но”!
Муж этой злодейки — мой любимый персонаж, мой улюбчик!
Главная героиня, герои‑красавцы — пусть живут как хотят.
Я-то собиралась спокойно наслаждаться семейной жизнью
и счастливо жить с моим идеальным мужем.

Вот только…

— Пожалуйста, давайте разведёмся, миледи.

Мой милый муж, с дрожащим голосом и влажными глазами, просит развод?!
Сердце сжалось — я бы сделала для него всё, кроме одного.

— Нет. Возвращайся домой.

Как бы ни было — развод я не подпишу!
Я разорвала бракоразводные бумаги прямо перед лицом Юклида.

Так начинается история женщины,
решившей любой ценой удержать своего «улюбчика» в объятиях,
пусть даже весь мир романа будет против неё.
description.pt-br:
Reencarnei em um romance de fantasia com harém reverso.
E não apenas como qualquer personagem, mas como Evgenia — a vilã mais notória que atormenta implacavelmente sua prima mais nova, a protagonista feminina, e persegue o Príncipe Herdeiro, um dos protagonistas masculinos, apesar de ser uma mulher casada!
Mas eis a questão…
O marido da vilã é, na verdade, meu personagem favorito. Então, enquanto os personagens principais são livres para viver suas vidas como bem entenderem, eu planejo viver feliz para sempre com meu amado.
No entanto…
“Por favor, vamos nos divorciar, minha senhora.”
Meu marido, à beira das lágrimas, faz um pedido inacreditável. Seus olhos marejados amolecem meu coração, apesar de mim mesma. Tudo bem, se for pelo meu personagem favorito… Se o que você realmente quer é se divorciar de mim…!
“Não, eu não vou. Volte para o seu quarto.”
Uma coisa é certa: eu nunca vou conceder o divórcio a ele! Rasguei os papéis do divórcio bem na frente do Euclides.

description.en:
When I died, I was reincarnated into my favorite novel as Iena, a supporting character and an actress - a profession scorned in the Empire. After reincarnating, I had to "discipline" a few pests who kept bothering me.

Then one day, the Crown Prince approached me with a strange proposal…

"I heard there’s no man who doesn’t fall from just one of your gestures."
I think we’re imagining very different kinds of gestures here.

"They say no one can meet your eyes when you smile."
That’s because they’re scared of me…

"Use whatever means necessary to make the Duke fall for you."
Excuse me, Your Highness… I think you’ve come to the wrong person!

The Duke is the male lead, and he already has a destined female lead he’s supposed to fall in love with!! I agreed to the Crown Prince’s plan, deciding to just hang in there until the real female lead shows up.

...but something’s gone off track?

"Your Grace, desire isn’t inherently bad. If you want something, speak up confidently. But if the other person says no, you step back. That’s all it takes."
"Is that so?"
"Yes."
"Then allow me to be bold. Iena, I wish to hold you."

… Are you being serious right now?
description.fr:
Ji So Eun entre soudainement dans le corps de Lena, étonnement malgré qu'elle soit un personnage secondaire elle avait beaucoup de personnes autour d'elle.

«Vous avez fait que tant d'hommes s'agenouillent à vos pieds avec ce corps, n'est-ce pas?»

Quel rumeur étrange... Après avoir entendu cette dernière, le prince héritier me propose de séduire le protagoniste masculin Caleb. Celui-ci aimera de toute façon la protagoniste féminine, alors j'ai décidé d'accepter en tenant bon jusqu'à son arrivée. Mais quelque chose a changé et Caleb ne semble plus intéressé par l'héroïne!
description.id: Sebelum aku meninggal, aku dirasuki oleh novel kesukaanku. Sebagai aktor pendukung, ‘Iena’, sebuah profesi yang dipandang rendah di kekaisaran. Setelah gelanggang es, banyak lelaki yang mengomel, jadi saya membantu mereka. Suatu hari, putra mahkota datang dan memberikan tawaran aneh… “Mereka bilang tidak ada orang yang tidak akan jatuh karena sentuhan tangan.” Isyarat dan makna yang Anda pikirkan mungkin berbeda…. “Tidak ada seorang pun yang bisa menatap matamu dengan senyumanmu.” Itu membuatku takut… … . “Anda tidak perlu pilih-pilih tentang cara dan metode.” "Buatlah sang duke jatuh cinta padamu." Permisi, Yang Mulia…! Saya pikir Anda mendatangi orang yang salah untuk menanyakan pertanyaan ini!!! Sang duke memiliki tokoh utama laki-laki dan tokoh utama perempuan yang ia cintai!! Setelah memutuskan untuk mengikuti saran putra mahkota, Aku memutuskan untuk bertahan sampai aku bertemu dengan tokoh utama wanitanya… Ada yang salah? “Yang Mulia, keinginan bukanlah hal yang buruk. Jika Anda ingin melakukan sesuatu, katakan saja. Namun jika orang lain berkata tidak, mundurlah. “Kalau begitu, semuanya akan baik-baik saja.” “Benarkah begitu?” "Ya." “Kalau begitu saya berani bertanya. “Iena, aku ingin memelukmu.”… Apakah kamu serius?
description.ko:
죽기 전, 가장 좋아하던 소설 속으로 빙의해 버렸다.
제국에서 천대받던 직업의 배우, 조연 ‘이에나’로.

빙의 후, 주위에 치근덕거리는 놈들이 많아 손 좀 봐줬더니
어느 날 황태자가 찾아와 이상한 제의를 하는데…

“네 손짓 한 번에 안 쓰러지는 남자가 없다고 하던데.”

그쪽이 생각하는 손짓과 의미가 다를 텐데요….

“네 눈웃음에 다들 눈도 못 마주친다고.”

그건 나한테 쫄아서…….

“수단과 방법을 가리지 않아도 좋다.”
“공작이 네게 빠지게 만들어.”

저기요, 전하…! 부탁할 사람을 잘못 찾아오신 것 같은데요!!!
공작은 남자 주인공에, 사랑에 빠질 여자 주인공이 따로 있다고요!!

황태자의 제의에 따르기로 한 후,
여자 주인공을 만날 그때까지만 버티기로 했는데…
뭔가 일이 꼬여 버렸다?

“공작님, 욕구는 결코 나쁜 게 아니에요. 하고 싶으면 당당히 말하세요.
하지만 상대가 싫다고 하면 물러나세요. 그러면 돼요.”
“그렇습니까.”
“네.”
“그럼 감히 청하겠습니다. 
이에나, 당신을 안고 싶습니다.”


……진심이세요?
description.ru:
Перед смертью я неожиданно перенеслась в мир любимого романа. В роли второстепенного персонажа по имени Иэна, которую презирала вся Империя, я оказалась между несколькими сильными мужчинами. Однажды ко мне пришел принц и сделал странное предложение:
- Говорят, ни один мужчина не может устоять, стоит тебе только взмахнуть рукой. Никто не решается смотреть тебе в глаза. - Это потому что они боятся...
- Не стесняйся и используй любые средства. Заставь герцога влюбиться в тебя.
Эй, Ваше Высочество!.. Кажется, вы не к тому человеку обратились! Герцог — главный герой, а у главной героини есть своя любовь!
После того, как я согласилась следовать предложению принца, я решила дотерпеть до встречи с женским главным героем...
- Герцог, желания вовсе не являются чем-то плохим. Если вы хотите, говорите об этом открыто. Но если другой человек не хочет, отступите. И всё.
- Это правда?
- Да.
- Тогда, с позволения, я попрошу. Иэна, я хочу тебя обнять.
- Вы серьёзно?

description.en:
The protagonist has possessed the body of Kang Shin-hyuk, a minor supporting character in a novel.

Deciding to leave the task of saving the world to the original heroes, Shin-hyuk plans to simply enjoy his new life. Unlike his past life, he now possesses a handsome face, a thick bank account, and the body of a B-Rank Hunter. His only goal: to live a popular, "insider" life without disrupting the original plot.

However, reality hits during a staff dinner when he faces discrimination for graduating from a non-Hunter school—a detail that never appeared in the original novel.

Disgusted by the two-faced nature of his fellow teachers, he decides he can't stay quiet if he wants to avoid being looked down upon. To secure the comfortable, popular life he desires, he begins to seek out "hidden pieces" of power. Even if it means altering the original story slightly, he decides he must become strong enough to protect himself.
description.ko:
소설 속 조연 강신혁으로 빙의하게 된 주인공. 

세상을 구하는 일은 원작 주인공들에게 맡기기로 하고 전생과는 달리 통장에 돈도 두둑하고 잘생긴 B급헌터의 몸으로 인싸생활을 목표로 소설을 거스르지 않기로 한 강신혁.

하지만 회식자리에서 원작에는 나오지 않았던 비 헌터학교 출신들에 대한 차별을 겪는다.

그렇게 앞뒤가 다른 주변 교사들을 보며 자신이 무시당하지 않기 위해, 자신의 편안한 인싸생활을 만들기 위해 원작의 내용을 조금 바꾸더라도 기연을 찾아 제 몸 하나 지킬 수 있을 정도를 목표로 강해지기 시작한다.

Han Bomi is a paralegal who moved to L&B law firm after being caught up in rumours that she had seduced a man with a fiancée.  
  
There, she meets Eren, the new CEO of the L&B law firm, a man with a dangerous vibe.  
  
Bomi’s resemblance to someone attracted her to Eren and although he is constantly concerned about Bomi, she always feels intimidated.  
  
“Don’t flinch. There is no one who can hurt you.”  
  
“Yes, I wasn’t like this from the beginning. It won’t be easy but I’ll change slowly but surely.”  
  
A romantic drama about the growth of a woman who is proudly reborn with the love of a man who looked dangerous!

description.en: Adrienne Trovica, the sole Grand Duchess of the Rhonta Empire, suddenly dies from a seizure and wakes up in the body of Countess Bleiah Acacia, who looks exactly like her. As it turns out, Bleiah is no ordinary woman. She was the mistress of Adrienne’s loving husband, Noevian Trovica. Adrienne, shocked by the news, attends her funeral as Bleiah to confirm the rumor. To her surprise, she sees a man crying for her at her grave. Who is this mystery man, and was everything that she knew about her husband a lie?
